label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for the admin meeting

Renee, here's my rundown for the meeting. It was a good week.

GAME: We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday night. That locks up 2nd in the region. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 TDs, and his long one in the 3rd quarter was something else. Our line pushed them back 5 yards on that whole drive, the best blocking I've seen out of them all year. Our defense held them to 46 yards rushing in the second half. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles, and the kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even sat down to talk about it. That tells you a lot about this team.

PLAYOFFS: We got a HOME playoff game. We host Clanton Valley in the first round this Friday, Nov 13, 7pm at Ridge Field. I want Dr. Pruitt to know so he can come out, and I'd love for staff and families to pack the place. Presale starts Tuesday. Gate crew and chain crew are getting confirmed by Wednesday.

ACADEMICS: All 52 kids on the roster passed the 9 weeks grade check. Nobody on the ineligible list. That's all Tonya Greer. Her Tuesday/Thursday study hall is the reason, and she deserves the credit, not me. She's keeping it going through the playoffs.

BOOSTERS: The Boston butt sale finished at 208 butts sold and $6,240 raised against a goal of $4,500. The money is going toward new sideline headsets. Hargrove's Meat Market did the smoking at cost, so that's worth a shout-out. The boosters also need 6 more volunteers for concessions on Friday, and a sign-up sheet is going out.

BUSES: If we win Friday and go on the road, I'll get you the bus request. I know transportation needs it 5 days out.

Let me know if you need anything else for the board report.

Coach Tillman
